Documentation → Reference → Permissions

Permissions reference

Every permission key SATOM checks, which seeded profile holds it, and which articles need it. Generated from app/permissions.py at build time, so it cannot drift from the code.

👤 ForAdministrator

System profiles

A user is assigned a profile — a set of granular area.action keys. Three system profiles are seeded and reproduce the original three roles exactly; administrators can compose custom profiles from the same keys. See Users & profiles.

  • readonly — Read-only access to every section. Cannot change anything.
  • operator — Read everything plus manage appliances, protection, network, backups and operations. No user or registry administration.
  • admin — Full access, including user and profile administration.

❗Important — anti-lockout

SATOM guarantees at least one active user always keeps both users.manage and profiles.manage. An edit that would remove the last such user is refused.
